comment: Declared capabilities of every model this project compares against. Each `evidence` string says HOW the claim was established, and each `class_evidence` entry does the same per instruction class. tools/check_capability_matrix.py refuses any claim without recorded evidence, because a capability matrix built on assumption is how a test quietly ends up running against something that does not implement what the test needs.
scope: These declarations establish what each model CAN adjudicate. They are not evidence that any model PASSED anything.

mosaicrv.evidence: Read from config/profiles/p0.json and validated by tools/check_profile.py; not hand-written here.

class_evidence.I: I-010/I-011, verified by CASE=decode.rv64im_reserved and CASE=alu.boundaries
class_evidence.M: I-008 implements the eight operations inline; exercised by p04_mul and p11_bigmuldiv in the corpus
class_evidence.Zicsr: I-008, exercised by every trapping corpus program through the firmware trap handler
class_evidence.Zifencei: I-037 is NOT yet implemented; fence.i decodes and retires as a no-op in this bring-up core

spike.evidence: Built from source (riscv-isa-sim commit 0bff12123b1fd510e19e19634dd997dbade70e54) at ~/mosaic-ref/install/bin/spike; `spike --help` reports the default ISA string rv64imafdc_zicntr_zihpm. Run over the p0 corpus by tests/programs/audit/spike_crosscheck.py: 33 of 39 cases agree word for word.

class_evidence.M: default ISA string contains m; p04/p11 agree with the oracle
class_evidence.Zicsr: zicntr/zihpm in the default string; the corpus reads mstatus/mepc/mcause and agrees
class_evidence.Zifencei: zifencei is implemented per the ISA string
class_evidence.V: v in the default string; NOT independently confirmed at VLEN=128 for this build

limits: MISMATCH: services misaligned accesses natively instead of trapping, and exposes no option to change it. p08_misaligned's trap expectations are therefore NOT_CLAIMED against Spike.

MISMATCH: reports cause 6 for an aligned store to a non-writable region where the specification requires cause 7, because the harness models boot_rom as unmapped rather than read-only. p13_romstore is NOT_CLAIMED against Spike.

nemu.evidence: Built in the Lima guest mosaic-rosetta at ~/mosaic-ref/NEMU-f39e-pinned, commit f39e3077d7bac3cd9a3a853a9300a5f8f0293a2c. Build product build/riscv64-nemu-interpreter-so, SHA-256 8a6f428dda7b6696fbc38a9413228a238c0fe59b0c08544d84f2d9c7d3417689, exporting difftest_init/difftest_exec/difftest_attach. Ran upstream CoreMark against XiangShan: HIT GOOD TRAP, 663692 instructions, 463152 cycles.

class_evidence.Zicsr: used by every CoreMark CSRRW/CSRRS instruction during the positive control
class_evidence.A: part of the riscv64 base profile in NEMU
class_evidence.C: part of the riscv64 base profile in NEMU

limits: NOT A DUT VERIFICATION PATH YET: no MosaicRV adapter produces or consumes the Difftest state layout. NEMU being built and running proves the reference works, not that MosaicRV has been compared against it.
Zifencei NOT separately established for this build.

xiangshan.evidence: Checkout at ~/mosaic-ref/XiangShan-e7bab53 in the Lima guests, commit e7bab53e66dfb3c4a1d11cf9519b0396f8576cae, 157/157 recursive gitlinks matching, worktree clean. Emulator built at build/verilator-compile/emu, SHA-256 72186b6c089932c6cc7e1915dd0674f3971eda5f38918382b3c2f46a3f83a5ed. Note build/emu is a DANGLING symlink and must not be used.

class_evidence.I: runs the CoreMark workload under differential testing
class_evidence.M: runs the CoreMark workload under differential testing
class_evidence.Zicsr: exercised by CoreMark and visible in its commit trace
class_evidence.A: upstream XiangShan implements A; NOT confirmed against our corpus
class_evidence.C: upstream XiangShan implements C; NOT confirmed against our corpus
class_evidence.F: upstream XiangShan implements F/D; NOT confirmed against our corpus
class_evidence.D: upstream XiangShan implements F/D; NOT confirmed against our corpus
class_evidence.V: upstream XiangShan implements RVV; NOT confirmed against our corpus

Its own CoreMark run is an upstream calibration, not a MosaicRV result.
